content:
Six years ago at Mage Unconference in Germany, two CEOs walked into a room full of their competitors' biggest advocates. (Yes it sounds like the beginning of a joke. Stefan and Sebastian Hamann, co-CEOs of Shopware, attended a Magento community event. Not to sell, recruit, or poach developers. They showed up because that's what genuine community participation looks like.

In this issue

  • What Real Community Looks Like. Many platforms claim to value community, but their messaging targets shareholders, agencies, and enterprise buyers.
  • A Note on the US Magento Community. In Europe, the Magento community remains vibrant.
  • Why Communities That Welcome Competitors Win. Platform tribalism carries real costs. When communities operate as silos, developers become trapped.
  • Becoming a Shopware Partner. After meeting Stefan and Sebastian in Germany, Wagento became a Shopware partner.
  • What Changes When Communities Open. Three outcomes emerge when community stops being treated as a competitive moat:
  • Communities Are Not Silos. Shopware is 25 years old, older than Shopify.
